work.plan:
Setting: A remote town surrounded by forests

Story: A mysterious blizzard affects the town, causing unusual environmental contamination and strange creatures to appear.

Objective: Explore the affected region, solve puzzles to progress

Gameplay: Players can walk, sprint, interact with objects, open and close their inventory, and equip useful gear.

Progression: Each stage contains clues, and puzzles that must be completed to access the next area.

Inventory: Players collect useful items, equipment, and clues throughout their exploration.

Reasoning: These decisions create a connected gameplay experience where exploration, puzzles, and story progression work together.

huddle.goal: Create a playable exploration and puzzle game set in a remote town affected by a mysterious blizzard. The player will explore different areas, interact with the environment, collect items, solve puzzles.  The smallest playable result will include one starting town area, basic player movement, interactive objects, an inventory, and at least one puzzle.
huddle.personal:
I understand that the goal is to create an exploration-based game with puzzle solving mechanics. I will develop the game's story, plan the regions and puzzles, implement gameplay features, and test that the interactions and progression work correctly.

I will also ensure that the inventory, settings, save/load system, and interface function as intended and meet the project requirements.

requirements.title: Working project foundation
requirements.evidence: Working source and build (60); authored program logic (35); meaningful tests (20); run guide and evidence map (20); individual explanation (15).

requirements.title: External playtest and revision
requirements.evidence: Use consented feedback from at least three testers; document problems, fixes and retest evidence.

requirements.title: Save and restore progress
requirements.evidence: Save meaningful state; close and reopen the program; demonstrate correct restoration and invalid-file handling.

requirements.title: Settings that persist
requirements.evidence: Provide useful settings, validate changes, save them and demonstrate restoration. This must extend beyond the same progress data.

requirements.title: Inventory or structured collection
requirements.evidence: Add, remove and inspect structured items. Test limits and invalid actions.

requirements.title: Search, sort and filter
requirements.evidence: Demonstrate useful search/filter combinations and empty/error states over a real collection.

requirements.title: Accessible controls and interface
requirements.evidence: Demonstrate keyboard access, readable contrast, clear feedback and one user-tested accessibility improvement.
